name: dataiku-dss-copilot
description: Codex plugin for inspecting, auditing, debugging and improving Dataiku DSS projects.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect, audit and debug Dataiku DSS projects from Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin that connects to Dataiku DSS through MCP and provides expert skills for Flow analysis, recipe debugging, Managed Folder inspection, RAG pipeline auditing and documentation generation.
